args.query:
INSERT OR REPLACE INTO cohort_summary (cohort, cohort_size, example_comment, created_at)
SELECT 
    cohort,
    COUNT(*) as cohort_size,
    (SELECT MIN(contact_notes) FROM participants p2 WHERE p2.cohort = participants.cohort AND contact_notes IS NOT NULL) as example_comment,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
FROM participants
GROUP BY cohort;
SELECT * FROM cohort_summary ORDER BY cohort;
